text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1501, 8-1/2" Brass Pineapple Door Knocker

The Large Palm Springs Pineapple Door Knocker is made out of sandcast brass and has a unique polished and highlighted brass finish that really brings out the magnificent detailing of the piece. This Premium Hospitality Pineapple Door Knocker is big, measuring 8.5 inches tall and 4 inches wide, making it right at home on even larger doors. But the 8-1/2 inch Brass Pineapple Front Door Knocker isn't too big for standard size doors either. It's a statement piece and a lasting first impression so that any guest will get a taste of your personal style just from knocking on your front door.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Also Available smaller 6-1/2" Brass Pineapple Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Pineapple Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Polished and Highlighted Brass
  • Height: 8-1/2
  • Width: 4" at widest part
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 5-3/16"
  • Projection Off Door: 2-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Available in 3 finishes:
Brass Nickel Silver Oiled Bronze

Sold Individually
